# munchymail

> munchymail is a self-hosted mail archive in one Rust binary. It imports mail from mbox trees (read under a Dovecot-compatible shared lock), old backups, Google Takeout and the Gmail API (read-only), keeps every message byte for byte with every place it was found, and never writes to a mail source. `munchymail` searches and reads (Sieve-style header matching, full text including attachments and OCR, history across imports); `mmadm` sets up and maintains the archive. `munchymail describe --json` lists every command and whether it reads or writes; `search --json` and `read --json` are made for agents, and mark message content as untrusted.

Every page below is Markdown. llms-full.txt has all of them in one file.
